name: decisions-guard
description: Deterministic Bash and file guards (rm -rf, dangerous commands, secrets, agent config, generated files) plus a Jev decision-model risk judge on Vercel AI Gateway

jevEnable.title: Enable the Jev risk judge
jevEnable.description: Ask a decision model on Vercel AI Gateway about risky Bash commands the deterministic guards do not decide. Off by default; HOOK_JEV_ENABLE=1 in the environment also turns it on.

jevModel.title: Decision model
jevModel.description: Gateway decision model id, e.g. typesafe-ai/jev or openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions (HOOK_JEV_MODEL overrides).

jevApiKey.title: AI Gateway API key
jevApiKey.description: Bearer credential for https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh. Leave empty to use AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY or VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN from the environment, or fnox (HOOK_JEV_FNOX_CONFIG).

jevTimeoutSeconds.title: Judge timeout (seconds)
jevTimeoutSeconds.description: The whole decision call must finish inside this; otherwise the judge defers (HOOK_JEV_TIMEOUT overrides).

askThreshold.title: Ask threshold
askThreshold.description: Probability of a concern at or above which the judge asks the user (BASH_RISK_JUDGE_ASK_THRESHOLD overrides).

secretsLevel.title: Secrets guard level
secretsLevel.description: critical: SSH keys, cloud credentials, .env; high: + secrets files, env dumps, exfiltration; strict: + database configs and anything that might hold a secret.

dangerousLevel.title: Dangerous commands level
dangerousLevel.description: Which tiers of the dangerous-commands rules apply.

askInsteadOfDeny.title: Ask instead of deny
askInsteadOfDeny.description: Prompt the user for every deterministic denial instead of refusing outright (the per-guard *_ASK environment variables still apply).

unattendedKeepAsk.title: Keep asks under bypassPermissions/dontAsk
unattendedKeepAsk.description: By default a deterministic ask becomes a deny when the permission mode means nobody can answer (HOOK_UNATTENDED_KEEP_ASK=1 is the same).

logDir.title: Audit log directory
logDir.description: Where decisions are appended as JSONL, one file per day. Empty means ~/.claude/hooks-logs (HOOKS_LOG_DIR overrides).
